title: Don't let the pictures fool you!
text: Don't let the pictures fool you!. I neglected to read the actual sizes of the bowls.  They are very small.

product_metadata.title: JoyJolt Kitchen Mixing Bowls - 8pc Glass Bowls with Lids Set – Neat Nesting Bowls - Large Mixing Bowl Set Batter Bowl - Cooking Bowls - Storage Bowls with Lids and Big Salad Bowl with BPA-Free Lids
features: Durable Bowls That Nest With Ease: When it comes to glass mixing bowls you want them sturdy thick clear and space saving right? If so you’ll probably love these four thick strong mixing bowls with lids They neatly nest for easy compact storage and tough enough for life! Cook for Joy by JoyJolt.

8pc Glass Mixing Bowls With Lids Set: The 2qt bowl is 8in wide and 4.25in tall while the next big bowl is 7.5x4in. Two med / small glass bowls include 6.25x3in and 5.5x2.5in. From large bowl to small glass bowl each one nests into the other with the lids on, so nothing gets lost in your cupboard.

Thick Strong Glass Mixing Bowl Set: Made from thicker and more durable glass - your clear bowls are robust They’re Dishwasher Safe Freezer Safe and and Microwave Safe containers (*NOT THE LIDS). Both lids and bowls are fridge safe. Made for mixing chilling and heating – not oven safe.

Air Tight Lids For Fresher Food: The airtight lids means you can use them for a food prep bowl or leftovers without odors and air getting in or out! And while they’re incredibly firm fitting to prevent air or moisture creeping in the easy thumb tabs make them simple to remove when needed.

JoyJolt Nesting Mixing Bowls will arrive securely gift boxed like all JoyJolt Glassware and come with our robust 12-Month Warranty. So contact us if anything goes wrong And whether you’re using them for baking bowls or serving bowls we only have one rule - Live JoyFul and Cook for Joy!
